intro: Camp Kosh is an ogre encampment in the northern Badlands, inhabited by the aggressive Dustbelcher ogres. Perched near vital travel routes, its brutes prey on passing caravans and scavenge whatever equipment travelers leave behind in the harsh desert.

p: Situated in the northern wastes of the Badlands, Camp Kosh serves as the northernmost settlement of the Dustbelcher ogres, who also occupy neighboring camps like Boff, Cagg, and Wurg. The ogres stationed here take advantage of their proximity to the roads, raiding vulnerable supply lines journeying toward Kargath or westward into the Searing Gorge. When dwarven prospectors led by Sigrun Ironhew were forced to flee the excavation at Uldaman, the brutes of Camp Kosh swiftly raided their abandoned wagons, hauling away precious food rations and armaments into the dusty encampment.
